policy.description: Official-source register for helplines displayed by AARAMORA. Automated checks test source URLs only; they do not prove a helpline is staffed, reachable from every phone/network, or appropriate to every caller.
policy.automatedCheck: HTTP metadata reachability only. 403, 405, 429, timeouts and network errors are inconclusive and require human review.
policy.privacy: The checker sends no user information and downloads no source-page body.
